newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares seen firm, power sector buoyant.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares seen firm, power sector buoyant.

text.p: Chilean stocks are expected to open higher, with heavyweight electricity shares climbing for the second day in a row as fears of power rationing fade after weekend rain, said traders.
"Electricity companies will continue with their positive tilt as the rain has eased the water crisis at many dams," said one trader.
The water shortage forced many hydroelectric generators to buy high cost power from other producers to meet their supply contracts with consumers.
Chilean investors have already absorbed any possible increase in U.S. interest rates to be discussed by the Federal Reserve at its policy meeting Tuesday, said traders.
"We don't think it will have much repercussion. A small rise of 0.25 percentage points will not affect us much," said one dealer.
The 40-share .IPSA index ended Monday up 1.04 percent at 121.1 points.
